correctness.rationale: The full-text source gives H_d=d! A_d with A_d=sum_{j=0}^d (d-j+1)(-2)^j/j!. Legendre gives nu_2(2^j/j!)=s_2(j). For even d, the j=0 term is odd and every later term is even, so A_d is odd. For odd d, every j>=2 term has valuation at least two, leaving A_d congruent to 1-d modulo 4. This yields exact excess 1 when d is 3 modulo 4 and excess at least 2 when d is 1 modulo 4. No finite computation is used in the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Hypercubical hyperdeterminant degree is a canonical projective-dual invariant of the Segre tensor variety, and the same modern source explicitly compares it with ED degree. The theorem supplies a uniform arithmetic phase law across every tensor order, exactly identifying the dyadic discrepancy from the natural ED-degree factorial baseline on three of the four residue classes modulo four up to the first two layers. This is structural information not visible from asymptotics or finite degree tables.
